 The latest value from 2025 is 2.08 percent, an increase from 1.33 percent in 2024. In comparison, the world average is 5.41 percent, based on data from 128 countries. Historically, the average for the United Kingdom from 1971 to 2025 is 3.79 percent. The minimum value, -12.02 percent, was reached in 2020 while the maximum of 15.21 percent was recorded in 2022.  Definition: Exports of goods includes changes in the economic ownership of goods from residents of the compiling economy to non-residents, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. Exports of services includes services provided by residents to non-residents. This indicator denotes the percentage change over each previous year of the constant price (base year 2015) series in United States dollars.
